According to Press, in a understanding formally reached between Acting President of Bangladesh, Nazrul Islam and Mrs. Gandhi, India has officered assistance to Bangladesh Government for reconstruction and restoration of normalcy after liberation. Indian army and Mukti-Bahini will work under unified command over which commander of Indian forces will have full operational command. Agreement has taken into account necessity for Indian army and security forces to be in Bangladesh until normalcy is restored.
